mapper.select: INSERT INTO appr_task ( tenant_id, approval_request_id, approval_type, source_context, source_resource_type, source_resource_id, title, risk_level, requester_id, status, trace_id, evidence_schema, evidence_digest, target_digest, evidence_json, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, version ) VALUES ( #{entity.tenantId}, #{entity.approvalRequestId}, #{entity.approvalType}, #{entity.sourceContext}, #{entity.sourceResourceType}, #{entity.sourceResourceId}, #{entity.title}, #{entity.riskLevel}, #{entity.requesterId}, 'PENDING', #{entity.traceId}, #{entity.evidenceSchema}, #{entity.evidenceDigest}, #{entity.targetDigest}, CAST(#{entity.evidenceJson} AS JSONB), #{entity.createdAt}, #{entity.createdBy}, #{entity.updatedAt}, #{entity.updatedBy}, 0 ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, approval_request_id) DO UPDATE SET id = appr_task.id WHERE appr_task.approval_type = EXCLUDED.approval_type AND appr_task.source_context = EXCLUDED.source_context AND appr_task.source_resource_type = EXCLUDED.source_resource_type AND appr_task.source_resource_id = EXCLUDED.source_resource_id AND appr_task.title = EXCLUDED.title AND appr_task.risk_level = EXCLUDED.risk_level AND appr_task.requester_id = EXCLUDED.requester_id AND appr_task.trace_id = EXCLUDED.trace_id AND appr_task.evidence_schema = EXCLUDED.evidence_schema AND appr_task.evidence_digest = EXCLUDED.evidence_digest AND appr_task.target_digest = EXCLUDED.target_digest AND appr_task.evidence_json = EXCLUDED.evidence_json RETURNING id

INSERT INTO appr_model_approval_cancellation ( event_id, tenant_id, approval_request_id, source_context, source_resource_type, source_resource_id, actor_id, reason, trace_id, requested_at, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{cancellation.eventId}, CAST(#{cancellation.tenantId.value} AS BIGINT), #{cancellation.approvalRequestId}, #{cancellation.sourceContext}, #{cancellation.sourceResourceType}, #{cancellation.sourceResourceId}, CAST(#{cancellation.actorId} AS BIGINT), #{cancellation.reason}, #{cancellation.traceId}, #{cancellation.requestedAt}, 'PENDING', NOW(), NOW() ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, approval_request_id) DO UPDATE SET event_id = appr_model_approval_cancellation.event_id WHERE appr_model_approval_cancellation.event_id = EXCLUDED.event_id AND appr_model_approval_cancellation.source_context = EXCLUDED.source_context AND appr_model_approval_cancellation.source_resource_type = EXCLUDED.source_resource_type AND appr_model_approval_cancellation.source_resource_id = EXCLUDED.source_resource_id AND appr_model_approval_cancellation.actor_id = EXCLUDED.actor_id AND appr_model_approval_cancellation.reason = EXCLUDED.reason AND appr_model_approval_cancellation.trace_id = EXCLUDED.trace_id AND appr_model_approval_cancellation.requested_at = EXCLUDED.requested_at RETURNING id
mapper.insert: WITH cancellation AS ( SELECT cancellation.* FROM appr_model_approval_cancellation cancellation WHERE cancellation.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND cancellation.approval_request_id = #{approvalRequestId} AND cancellation.status = 'PENDING' FOR UPDATE ), cancelled AS ( UPDATE appr_task task SET status = 'CANCELLED', approver_id = cancellation.actor_id, decision_at = cancellation.requested_at, updated_at = cancellation.requested_at, updated_by = cancellation.actor_id, version = task.version + 1 FROM cancellation WHERE task.tenant_id = cancellation.tenant_id AND task.approval_request_id = cancellation.approval_request_id AND task.source_context = cancellation.source_context AND task.source_resource_type = cancellation.source_resource_type AND task.source_resource_id::text = cancellation.source_resource_id AND task.status = 'PENDING' AND task.deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING task.id AS task_id, cancellation.id AS cancellation_id, cancellation.tenant_id, cancellation.actor_id, cancellation.reason, cancellation.requested_at ), marked AS ( UPDATE appr_model_approval_cancellation cancellation SET status = 'APPLIED', task_id = cancelled.task_id, resolved_at = cancelled.requested_at, updated_at = NOW() FROM cancelled WHERE cancellation.id = cancelled.cancellation_id RETURNING cancelled.task_id, cancelled.tenant_id, cancelled.actor_id, cancelled.reason, cancelled.requested_at ) INSERT INTO appr_record ( tenant_id, task_id, actor_id, action, comment, action_at, created_at ) SELECT tenant_id, task_id, actor_id, 'CANCEL', reason, requested_at, NOW() FROM marked
mapper.update: UPDATE appr_model_approval_cancellation cancellation SET status = CASE WHEN task.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN 'APPLIED' ELSE 'DECISION_WON' END, task_id = task.id, resolved_at = COALESCE(task.decision_at, NOW()), updated_at = NOW() FROM appr_task task WHERE cancellation.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND cancellation.approval_request_id = #{approvalRequestId} AND cancellation.status = 'PENDING' AND task.tenant_id = cancellation.tenant_id AND task.approval_request_id = cancellation.approval_request_id AND task.source_context = cancellation.source_context AND task.source_resource_type = cancellation.source_resource_type AND task.source_resource_id::text = cancellation.source_resource_id AND task.status <> 'PENDING' AND task.deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE appr_task SET status = #{targetStatus}, approver_id = #{approverId}, decision_at = #{decisionAt}, updated_at = #{decisionAt}, updated_by = #{approverId}, version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{taskId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND deleted_at IS NULL

ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET #{query.offset}
